description: This file contains implementation of big integer operations and parsing functions related to string to number conversions, specifically handling large powers of 5 and digit parsing for floating-point mantissa conversion within the Abseil library.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: Template class for arbitrary-precision unsigned big integers used in parsing and conversion routines.

methods.name: ReadFloatMantissa
methods.description: Reads and converts a floating-point number's mantissa into a big unsigned integer representation.

methods.name: ReadDigits
methods.description: Parses digit characters from a string into a big unsigned integer, adjusting for decimal points and trailing zeros.

methods.name: FiveToTheNth
methods.description: Computes 5 raised to the power of n as a big unsigned integer, using precomputed large powers for efficiency.
